achievements.fence_body: izifinyezelo zihlobisa — aziniki amandla. Alikho igeyi lapha elibheka le khasi: ukufuna isihlalo kufuna ukuhlala, futhi akukho okunye (Art. I · CI-1). Futhi isevisi esibhala lokhu senqaba ukubala: sibuyisa izifinyezelo onazo, hhayi ukuthi zingaki (PI-6).
achievements.intro: Irekhodi lakho lokuzuzela — izinto zokuqala zomphakathi nohambo oluqedwe — ligcinwe njengohlu, hhayi njengesikolo. Akukho lutho kule khasi olunika noma yini: akukho kuvota, akukho isihlalo, akukho indima, futhi akukho kufanele, naphakade.
achievements.journeys_gloss: Izikhala zohambo oluqedwe zingamathiki azibikele zona ngokwabo — izinhamba eziholwayo ukuze zingathathi isikhundla sezinto ezivumelekiwe\
